title: Makes the reading light gradually brighter and darker
goal: Declare CSS transition in the normal state to smoothly switch transparency when the class name changes.
summary: toggle button will add or remove is-on for the reading light. Set the light-on state and add transitions to the two switching directions.
tasks: maintains 0.25 opacity in normal state, and sets the opacity of .reading-lamp.is-on to 1.
Add 300ms transition for opacity on .reading-lamp, use ease for easing.
Click "switching reading light" to observe that it lights up, and click again to observe that it goes out.

example.note: When the payment prompt enters or leaves the warning state, the background color will transition. Transitions in the normal state will take effect in both directions.

hint: When transition is declared only on .is-on, removing the class name also removes the transition. Place the declaration in the .reading-lamp base rule.
